scope: Resolved U source-wrench model replay, independent contact refinement, qualified reference cache/gauge and exact original failures

external_egg_termination.interpretation: External Slurm wall-time termination during supported initialization. No natural producer closure, final contact equilibrium or stage acceptance. Existing snapshots/logs preserved exactly; this record does not substitute producer closure.

refinement.scope: Audit resolved-contact mesh changes and reference-only gauge/cache candidates.
refinement.limitations: Two useful contact levels do not establish a tail. Body geometry and pad spatial discretization change together; separate axes, contact regularization, nonlinear pad compliance and full egg/Franka comparisons remain required. Cache and centre fixing are reference-only changes under exactly zero total x force. No wall-time speedup is inferred from factor reuse counts.
